note: Huron NF campground near Barton City (Alcona County, Huron Shores Ranger District), on the east side of 193-acre Jewell Lake, with swimming and motorized and non-motorized boating; spacious private sites, parking for about 32 vehicles. A snowmobile trail runs through the area in winter; the Reid Lake backcountry sites and trailheads are nearby. --Claude
